module: Editor ImGui widget for editing an easing curve (engine EaseF type). The value is a "dir type param0 param1" string. The widget shows two combos (direction InOut/In/Out, type Linear..Bounce), a clickable curve preview opening a thumbnail picker, and parameter sliders for Elastic (Amplitude, Period) and Back (Overshoot).
notes: The direction and type names must stay in sync with engine::Ease::enumDirection and enumType (the index equals the order in the enum).
A parameter of -1 means "default value of the curve".
Curves are sampled by worldEditorCppApi.getEaseCurveSamples (64 points for the preview, 32 for the thumbnails).

draw.desc: Draws the curve editing widget. Calls opts.setValue(valueString, editEnded) on each change; editEnded is true for combo/picker choices and at the end of a slider drag.

opts.desc: id (unique string), value (string "dir type param0 param1"), setValue(valueString, editEnded)
